text.EN: It's down... give me a second.
I got it... but my breath won't catch.
text.TL: Nakuha ko... pero kinakapos ako sa hininga.

text.EN: Dead... give me a moment to steady my hands.
text.TL: Patay na... bigyan mo ako ng saglit para kumalma ang kamay ko.

text.EN: It's down... that was way too close.
Just... wait a second. My chest hurts.
text.TL: Saglit lang... kumikirot ang dibdib ko.

text.EN: It's dead... hands are shaking like crazy.
text.TL: Patay na... nanginginig nang husto ang mga kamay ko.

text.EN: Got him down... need half a minute.
text.TL: Naibagsak ko... kailangan ko ng kalahating minuto.

text.EN: God... it's over. Give me a second.
text.TL: Diyos ko... tapos na. Sandali lang.

text.EN: Down... heart is pounding in my ears.
text.TL: Bagsak... dumadagundong ang puso sa tenga ko.

text.EN: It's finished... just give me a moment.
text.TL: Tapos na... bigyan mo lang ako ng saglit.
